meta.title: Embed Fixer | Discord bot for fixing social media embeds
meta.description: Embed Fixer reposts links from X, Pixiv, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and more so their previews actually show up in Discord. Used in 3700+ servers, open source, and self-hostable.

hero.tagline: When a social link doesn’t preview properly, Embed Fixer reposts it with a working embed, under the sender’s name.

problem.heading: Discord’s own previews often miss the part you wanted to share.

cards.name: Twitter/X
cards.text: Sometimes there’s no preview at all, sometimes half of one.

cards.name: Pixiv, Instagram
cards.text: You get a title card, but not the image.

cards.name: TikTok, Reddit
cards.text: Videos show up as a thumbnail that won’t play.

cards.name: Your members
cards.text: Have to open a browser just to see what you posted.

features.heading: Fixes links on its own, or by hand when you need it.

list.title: Automatic
list.text: Post a link as usual. Embed Fixer reposts it through a webhook with your name and avatar, plus a reaction you can use to delete it.

list.title: Fix by hand
list.text: Install it as a user app to use /fix or the right-click menu in DMs and servers that don’t have the bot.

list.title: Media extraction
list.text: In channels you pick, images and videos from X, Pixiv, Bluesky and Kemono posts are sent as files. Spoilered links stay spoilered.

list.title: Your rules
list.text: {count} settings cover which sites, channels and roles get fixes, and how the fixed message is sent. Members can opt out with /ignore-me.

platforms.heading: Big platforms and niche ones, most with several fix services to choose from.

customization.heading: If a default doesn’t suit your server, change it.
customization.body: Most of these settings were added because someone asked for them. Set them with /settings in Discord.
customization.noResults: No setting matches that. Try “role”, “channel” or “webhook”.

settings.label: Language
settings.description: Change the language used by the bot.

settings.label: Disable embed fixes for websites
settings.description: Turn off fixes for specific websites.

settings.label: Media extraction channels
settings.description: Extract images and videos from supported links in selected channels.

settings.label: Channel blacklist
settings.description: Channels here never receive embed fixes.

settings.label: Channel whitelist
settings.description: Only selected channels receive embed fixes. Overrides the blacklist.

settings.label: Webhook reply ping
settings.description: Choose whether replying through the webhook pings the original author.

settings.label: NSFW auto-spoiler
settings.description: Skip automatic spoiler tags for extracted media in selected NSFW channels.

settings.label: Delete reaction
settings.description: Add a reaction the original author can use to delete the webhook message.

settings.label: Show post text
settings.description: Show the post’s text in selected channels when media extraction is on.

settings.label: Delete reaction emoji
settings.description: Choose which emoji is used for delete-by-reaction.

settings.label: Embed fix service
settings.description: Choose which fix service is used for each website.

settings.label: Bot visibility
settings.description: Choose whether links sent by other bots are fixed too.

settings.label: Funnel to target channel
settings.description: Send fixed embeds and extracted media to one channel instead of the source.

settings.label: Whitelist roles
settings.description: Only members with selected roles get fixes. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Original link button
settings.description: Show or hide a button that links to the original post.

settings.label: Delete originals in threads
settings.description: Delete the original thread message after the fixed embed is sent.

settings.label: Fix mode
settings.description: Delete and resend through a webhook, reply to the original, or resend as the bot.

settings.label: Auto-remove delete reaction
settings.description: Remove the delete reaction after a set number of seconds.

settings.label: Rotate fix reaction
settings.description: Add a 🔄 reaction the original author can use to switch to the next fix service.

hosting.heading: Rather keep your data in-house? Host it yourself.
hosting.body: Embed Fixer is open source. Run it with Docker on SQLite or PostgreSQL, and your server settings stay on your own machine.

closing.heading: Add it once, and shared links preview properly from then on.
